summary: Blackstone Secured Lending Fund (BXSL) entered into an Eleventh Supplemental Indenture for $650 million aggregate principal amount of 5.900% notes due 2031, issued pursuant to an effective shelf registration statement on Form N-2ASR. The notes mature on May 21, 2031, bear semi-annual interest, and are unsecured general obligations ranking senior to subordinated debt, pari passu with unsecured unsubordinated debt, and effectively junior to secured debt. The fund may redeem notes at its option at any time. A change-of-control repurchase event triggers an offer to repurchase at 100% principal plus accrued interest. No terms such as price per share or premium are applicable. This debt issuance, while capital markets activity, does not fit any core special-situation category (e.g., capital return, restructuring); it is a routine shelf takedown. What to watch: the fund's asset coverage ratio compliance and note trading levels relative to straight corporate debt.
